question: Which divine authorities respond when an offense in supremacy arises?
premises: An offense in supremacy has been posited
Brahmā is the creator of the world
Viṣṇu is the lord of the worlds
inference: Brahmā and Viṣṇu, as world-creator and world-lord, respond to such an offense.
